summary: Establishment Labs Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended Credit Agreement on April 30, 2026, with Oaktree Fund Administration as administrative agent. The agreement provides up to $300 million in term loans in two tranches: a $265 million Tranche E advanced at closing and an up to $35 million Tranche F subject to mutual consent. Proceeds primarily repay $259 million of prior indebtedness and for working capital. Loans mature April 30, 2031, bear interest at 8.75% per annum, with a PIK toggle on the first anniversary. This refinancing is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special-situation event. There are no deal terms to report.
